<documents>
<document id="transfers-cancel">
CancellingˆaˆtransferˆWhetherˆyouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆdependsˆonˆtheˆtypeˆofˆtransferˆandˆhowˆfarˆalongˆitˆis.ˆ##ˆScheduledˆorˆpendingˆACHˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆACHˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆuntilˆtheˆACHˆcutoffˆtimeˆ(4:00ˆPMˆET)ˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆtransferˆandˆtapˆCancel.ˆAfterˆtheˆcutoff,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆalreadyˆonˆitsˆwayˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆarriveˆinstantlyˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆWiresˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆWeˆcanˆaskˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney,ˆbutˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆdecides,ˆandˆitˆisn'tˆguaranteed.ˆ##ˆRecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆstopˆfutureˆtransfersˆinˆaˆrecurringˆseriesˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStoppingˆtheˆseriesˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆthat'sˆalreadyˆpastˆitsˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆSentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆaccount?ˆIfˆanˆACHˆtransferˆwentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆexternalˆaccount,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆtryˆtoˆcontactˆtheˆotherˆbank,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆtheˆmoneyˆcomesˆback.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfers-recurring">
ScheduledˆandˆrecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆscheduleˆaˆtransferˆforˆaˆfutureˆdate,ˆorˆsetˆoneˆupˆtoˆrepeatˆweekly,ˆeveryˆtwoˆweeksˆorˆmonthly.ˆ##ˆSetˆoneˆupˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆaccount,ˆenterˆtheˆamount,ˆandˆtapˆSchedule.ˆPickˆtheˆdateˆandˆhowˆoftenˆitˆrepeats.ˆ##ˆWhenˆscheduledˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆOnˆtheˆscheduledˆdate,ˆACHˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆinˆtheˆbatchˆbeforeˆ4:00ˆPMˆET.ˆIfˆtheˆdateˆfallsˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆholiday,ˆthey'reˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆNotˆenoughˆmoneyˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆtooˆlowˆonˆtheˆsendˆdate,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆskippedˆandˆweˆnotifyˆyou.ˆWeˆdon'tˆretryˆit,ˆandˆthere'sˆnoˆfee.ˆFutureˆtransfersˆinˆtheˆseriesˆstillˆrun.ˆ##ˆChangeˆorˆstopˆEditˆorˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtimeˆbeforeˆtheˆcutoffˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆ##ˆTransfersˆtoˆsavingsˆRecurringˆtransfersˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆhappenˆinstantlyˆonˆtheˆscheduledˆday,ˆincludingˆweekends.ˆScheduledˆtransfersˆcountˆtowardˆyourˆdailyˆandˆmonthlyˆtransferˆlimitsˆonˆtheˆdayˆthey'reˆsent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="overdraft-no-fees">
Doˆyouˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfees?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆorˆnon-sufficientˆfundsˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆinsteadˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆhaveˆenoughˆmoney,ˆtheˆtransactionˆisˆsimplyˆdeclined.ˆThere'sˆnoˆchargeˆforˆaˆdecline.ˆ##ˆCushionˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆturnˆonˆCushion,ˆwhichˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆwhenˆyourˆbalanceˆrunsˆshort,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆCushionˆcoversˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ$200ˆonˆPremium.ˆItˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆCanˆmyˆbalanceˆstillˆgoˆnegative?ˆRarely.ˆItˆcanˆhappenˆwhenˆaˆmerchantˆchargesˆmoreˆthanˆitˆfirstˆauthorized,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆtipˆaddedˆtoˆaˆrestaurantˆbill,ˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆReturnedˆpaymentsˆIfˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆorˆanˆACHˆdebitˆcan'tˆbeˆpaid,ˆit'sˆreturnedˆunpaid,ˆwithˆnoˆfeeˆfromˆus.ˆTheˆcompanyˆyouˆoweˆmayˆchargeˆitsˆownˆlateˆfee.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Can I cancel a scheduled ACH transfer?

response.text: {"answer":"Yes. You can cancel a scheduled ACH transfer in the app before the 4:00 PM ET cutoff on its send date. Go to Transfers, select the transfer, and tap Cancel. After the cutoff, it can’t be cancelled.","citations":["transfers-cancel"],"escalate":false}
